{{Quote|What do you think, Stripe? They do this at every inspection?''"<br />"''Don't ask stupid questions, Bouncer.|Bouncer and Stripe|<ref name="Mouse Hunt" />}}
'''Bouncer''' was the name of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pastil/Legends|Pastil]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Bouncer was a member of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] complement of a local [[Pastil tracking station/Legends|tracking station]], which was assigned to warn the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] of impending attacks by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. When [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] arrived at the Pastil station on a routine inspection, they [[Skirmish on Pastil|uncovered]] a Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]] there, an [[MSE-series]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] nicknamed "[[Rodent (droid)|Rodent]]." Bouncer participated in the subsequent search for the droid, which was found and eliminated.

==Biography==
{{Quote|All right, this is a ''Code Aurek'' alert. I want each of you to search every nook, every cranny, for a place this Rodent could be hiding.|CT-7567, to the clone troopers stationed on Pastil|<ref name="Mouse Hunt" />}}
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] named "Bouncer"<ref name="Mouse Hunt" /> was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Like the rest of his clone brethren, Bouncer was bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Databank" /> He was unable to complete the required training before joining the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]];<ref name="Mouse Hunt" /> however, as the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] escalated, rookie clones such as Bouncer&mdash;the so-called [[Shiny/Legends|shinies]]&mdash;were rushed into service by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref> Bouncer was assigned to a remote [[Pastil tracking station/Legends|tracking station]]<ref name="Mouse Hunt" /> on the planet [[Pastil/Legends|Pastil]],<ref name="Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}}</ref> a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] that watched over enemy [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] movements and was supposed to warn the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] in case of an attack by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Mouse Hunt" />

[[File:Pastil-TCWWC05p01.png|thumb|left|250px|The Pastil tracking station]]
To help the clones in the station's maintenance, an [[MSE-series]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] also worked there. Nicknamed "[[Rodent (droid)|Rodent]]" by the clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], the droid diligently polished the premises; almost too diligently, as Bouncer and the other clones noticed, although they wrote it off to a glitch in the droid's programming.<ref name="Mouse Hunt" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Mouse Hunt date">{{TCWdates|105}} ''[[The Clone Wars: Mouse Hunt]]'' is set immediately prior to "Rookies," placing it in 22 BBY as well.</ref> [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] visited Pastil station for a routine inspection. They noted the unusual cleanliness of the outpost, and one of the clone troopers, [[Stripe]], informed them about Rodent's seeming obsession with keeping the station tidy.<ref name="Mouse Hunt" />

Upon hearing this, the two inspectors realized that the droid was, in fact, a Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]]; cleaning the outpost was just a cover while the droid spent its [[Time/Legends|time]] learning Republic secrets. The senior clones issued a [[Code Aurek]] alert and [[Skirmish on Pastil|ordered]] the clone troopers to find Rodent. During their search for the droid, Bouncer's inquiry into whether the clone [[Officer/Legends|officers]] randomly hunted cleaning droids at every inspection was met by a reprimand from Stripe. When the clone troopers finally found Rodent, the droid tried to escape, but Stripe destroyed the droid with a [[V-1 thermal detonator]], damaging a part of the station in the process. Leaving Bouncer and the rest of the shinies to clean up the mess, CC-2224 and CT-7567 departed Pastil.<ref name="Mouse Hunt" /> With Rodent's destruction, the Pastil outpost safely continued its operation.<ref name="Rookies" />

==Personality and traits==
When CC-2224 and CT-7567 ordered the hunt for Rodent, Bouncer questioned whether the clone officers performed station sweeps in search of droids during every inspection, a question that fellow trooper Stripe considered to be stupid.<ref name="Mouse Hunt" /> Like his genetic template, Jango Fett, Bouncer stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had [[Color/Legends|black]] hair and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bouncer appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Mouse Hunt|''Mouse Hunt'']], a short [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|webcomic]] written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], illustrated by [[Tom Hodges]], and published on [[StarWars.com]]. ''Mouse Hunt'' preceded "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Mouse Hunt" /> The planet on which Bouncer served was not named in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] itself, but it was identified as Pastil in the online episode guide for "Rookies."<ref name="Ep Guide" />
